parts.text: $ECHO Q3 2026: revenue $1.1B, down 69% Y/Y as service revenue dropped. Net earnings reached $2.8B, driven by non-operating items from debt actions. #earnings #media

$FBIN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.1B, -3% Y/Y, driven by lower water sales and portfolio actions. Operating margin 5.4%; operating cash flow $347M. Guides Q4 net sales to $925M–$995M. #earnings #materials
$CNK Q3 2026: revenue $1.1B, +24% Y/Y, driven by a stronger film slate and higher attendance across U.S. and international markets. Operating margin 11.6%. #earnings #streaming

$SWKS Q4 FY26 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, -5% Y/Y, as standalone results precede its combination with Qorvo. Operating margin 2.1%, with management targeting over $500M in annual cost synergies. #earnings #semiconductors
$CVS Q3 2026: revenue $108.4B, +5% Y/Y, driven by growth in Health Services and Health Care Benefits segments. Operating margin 3.3%; operating cash flow $4.7B. #earnings #retail

$CAT Q3 2026: revenue $20.7B, +17% Y/Y, driven by higher sales volume and favorable price realization across its primary segments. Operating margin 20.4%; net earnings $3.3B and operating cash flow $4.4B. #earnings #industrials
$PFGC Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $18.0B, +6% Y/Y, driven by independent foodservice case volume growth. Operating margin 1.5%. #earnings #industrials
$UBER Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $14.8B, +10% Y/Y, driven by record audience and consumer engagement. Operating margin 9.8%. #earnings #industrials
$NVO Q3 2026: revenue DKK 79.2B, +6% Y/Y, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across operations, led by obesity. Operating margin 29.1%; net earnings DKK 16.7B. #earnings #pharma

$AVT Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $10.7B, +82% Y/Y, driven by stronger demand across core verticals including industrial, aerospace, and defense. Operating margin 4.4%; net earnings $282M. #earnings #industrials

$CHSCP Q4 FY26: revenue $10.4B, +21% Y/Y, driven by strong oilseed crush and ethanol margins, alongside solid refining results. Operating margin 5.8%; operating cash flow $1.4B. #earnings #industrials
$MCD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $7.2B, +1% Y/Y, driven by higher franchised margins. Operating margin reached 50.2% as global comparable sales grew. #earnings #restaurants
